results.title: Ludovic
results.overview: Ludovic Tézier is today one of the greatest baritones in the world. Behind this major voice of opera, both backstage and in everyday life, is a simple man, passionate about his art, but also his wife, Cassandre Berthon, a soprano. From the most prestigious stages to the intimacy of their home, from rehearsals to masterclasses, both the demands of interpretative work and the depth of soul that inhabits him are revealed. Driven by his natural humanity and the strength of his love, Ludovic unveils what makes Tézier’s voice exceptional.

results.title: Midnight Momo
results.overview: Kunga’s having a hell of a night. It’s 15 minutes to closing at the Queens momo shop where he works and things are just heating up. A homeless regular comes in for his nightly leftovers. Kunga’s girlfriend arrives with something serious to talk about. Immigration officers show up looking for the Mexican chef. Then, just as everything is boiling over, the clock strikes midnight and Kunga finds himself right back where he started — trapped in the same chaotic 15 minutes over and over.

results.title: Trick
results.overview: Successful illustrator Daniele Mallarico travels to Naples to look after his four-year-old grand-son while his daughter is away for a few days. What begins as a simple babysitting job turns into a subtle psychological duel, as the child’s boundless imagination slowly unsettles him. Trapped together in the apartment, Daniele is forced to confront something far more disturbing than a mischievous child: the fear of aging and the loss of creativity. Through this strange encounter, he may rediscover the power of imagination he thought he had lost.

results.title: Nino – A Film About Nino Rota
results.original_title: Nino - Un film su Nino Rota
results.overview: An in-depth documentary into the life of renowned Italian composer Nino Rota, who wrote the score for 16 films directed by Federico Fellini, including “La Strada,” “8 1/2,” “Juliet of the Spirits” and “Amarcord,” besides “La Dolce Vita.” He also composed music for Franco Zeffirelli’s “Romeo and Juliet” and the Sicilian-inspired theme for “The Godfather,” whose “Part II” score won him his only Oscar. Rota’s 150 films also included collaborations with King Vidor (“War and Peace”) and Luchino Visconti (“The Leopard”). Rota died at 68 in 1979.

results.title: Entre deux âges, portraits d'une jeunesse
results.original_title: Entre deux âges, portraits d'une jeunesse
results.overview: One late summer afternoon, in a suburb in the far north of France, on the outskirts of Calais and the sea. Children and teenagers kill time at the foot of the tower blocks, between buildings and vacant lots. They talk about love, doubts, and hopes, trying to understand what drives them.

results.title: Treasure of the Lost Reel
results.overview: An out of work, fantasy-prone film preservationist finds the only print of a sought-after animated film that a corporate assassin has been sent to destroy.

results.title: Team JuL
results.overview: Jul, a true rap phenomenon, has become in just a few years the new face of Marseille. A kid from the working-class neighborhoods who, with a €20 microphone and a bedroom turned into a studio, reshaped French rap. Independent and hyper-productive, he imposes his own style and brings together all generations. Behind the auto-tune and Kalenji tracksuits lies a cultural revolution that is disrupting the established rules of the entertainment industry and extending far beyond the city of Marseille.

results.title: Otter Lake
results.overview: A year in the life of choreographer Emma Portner as she creates new work, confronts personal and physical challenges, and searches for artistic freedom between Otter Lake and Europe.

results.title: Karikaada
results.overview: Divine love transforms Kaada's hunting heritage into an epic tale of adventure, action, and romance, leading him to abandon his former life.

results.title: Jakob & Anxiety
results.overview: Jacob, aged 22, navigates his way through everyday situations, constantly accompanied by Anxiety, an intrusive and manipulative presence that only he can see.  When Jacob is reunited with Mille, a girl from his past, he is forced to confront the voice that has controlled his life.  In a surreal inner journey where fantasy and reality merge, Jacob learns that anxiety cannot be eradicated—but it can be faced, named and lived with. The film blends realism, humour and visual metaphor to explore vulnerability, mental health and the courage it takes to let someone see who you really are.

results.title: Dough Man
results.overview: When a quirky newcomer moves in, the eldest of three sisters, Evelyn, becomes convinced he’s a witch. Her middle sister dismisses it, the youngest falls for him, and Evelyn descends into a string of increasingly absurd attempts to prove her theory, ending with one final test.
